exercises.question: In a formal HR report, which sentence correctly states that management expects the staff (a different subject) to respect the new working hours?
options: La dirección espera respetar la nueva jornada laboral.
La dirección espera que la plantilla respeta la nueva jornada laboral.
La dirección espera para la plantilla respetar la nueva jornada laboral.
La dirección espera que la plantilla respete la nueva jornada laboral.

exercises.sentence: Conviene que el sindicato ____ el acuerdo de conciliación antes de la reunión.
exercises.english: It is advisable that the union review the work-life balance agreement before the meeting.

exercises.sentence: Tras el despido, la ley exige que la empresa pague la indemnización en un plazo breve.
options: Before the dismissal, the law requires the company to pay the severance pay within a short deadline.

After the dismissal, the law requires the company to pay the severance pay within a short deadline.
After the dismissal, the law requires the union to pay the severance pay within a short deadline.
